sources.note: K&M 210/9 data sheet, variant 21090-300-55 black (opened, text read, page rendered): height from 900 to 1,605 mm, boom arm length from 435 to 745 mm, 2-piece telescopic boom with T-bar locking screw, 2-piece folding rod with clutch, socket with foldable legs, steel, zinc die-cast base, 3/8 in threaded connector, 3.1 kg, size when folded 105 x 85 x 985 mm. The page has one product photo (stand, slight perspective) and no dimension drawing.

K&M product page for the 210/9 black (opened): same technical data as the data sheet (900-1,605 mm, boom 435-745 mm, folded 105 x 85 x 985 mm, 3.1 kg, 3/8 in thread). No base diameter, no tube diameters, no drawing: the 700 x 700 mm footprint is a photo estimate (leg tips about 650 mm apart in the data sheet photo, scaled on the 1,605 mm height), not a published figure.
